data.name: Short Rations
data.description:
The tide keeps leaving the Wreck's crew on the Salvager's beach, and they keep dragging her crates back to the hull as if it were still their watch. Thin them out: 3 Looting Deckhands and a Quartermaster's Mate, for 3 Wreck Salvage.

Ask the Salvager at her fire on the beach below the Wreck (sector 210). Enemies match your level. You start each fight at full health, chakra and stamina. Lose one and the job ends.
data.successDescription: You kept her crates on her sand.

objectives.description: "Thin them out and I'll pay you. My crates, my sand." Down the beach, two deckhands are hauling one of her crates toward the hull, in step, without a word.
They set the crate down and turn to you, the way they'd turn to an order.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: Further along the tideline a Quartermaster's Mate is counting crates off a list, and a third deckhand is stacking them. Neither looks up.
The Mate closes his list and calls the stack to order.
objectives.drawDescription: The fight stalls, and the tide takes the way back.
objectives.fleeDescription: You break away, and the tide closes behind you.

objectives.description: Her crates stay on her sand, for today. You bring back what they were hauling.
The crew carry on past you as if you were never there. The tide will turn again tomorrow.
